name: Courmayeur

seo.title: Courmayeur ski resort guide
seo.description: 100 km of groomed slopes and off-piste terrain across 33 runs, under Mont Blanc on the Italian side.
seo.twitterDescription: 100 km of slopes under the Italian side of Mont Blanc.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Courmayeur in the Aosta Valley.

h1: Courmayeur ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Courmayeur sits at 1,224 metres on the Italian side of Mont Blanc, which at 4,810 metres is the highest peak in the Alps, in Italy and in Europe. The cable car from the village opens a ski area the operator counts as 100 kilometres of groomed slopes and off-piste terrain across 33 runs, with separate freeride, ski-touring and heliski terrain beyond it.
stayOverview: The old village sits below the cable car with Via Roma as its pedestrian spine; Dolonne and Entrèves are across the river and up the valley towards the Mont Blanc tunnel.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The village centre puts you on Via Roma and a short walk from the cable car.
rentalCars: Courmayeur is at the Italian mouth of the Mont Blanc tunnel, about 35 kilometres from Aosta.

verticalDrop.note: Arp down to Dolonne, the figure the lift company publishes.

topElevation.note: Cresta d'Arp, the top of the lift system. The highest piste tops out at Cresta Youla, 2,624 m.

season.note: The lift company announces the winter season start; no closing date is published.

snowpark.note: With a progressive area of three lines of rails for every level.

pistes.note: 100 km counting the off-piste, on two sides of the mountain - Val Veny and Plan Checrouit.

baseElevation.note: Dolonne, which the lift company lists as its minimum lift altitude. Courmayeur itself sits at 1,224 m and Plan Checrouit, mid-mountain, at 1,704 m.

longestRun.note: The lift company names it the longest run and gives its vertical drop as 1,545 m, but publishes no length in kilometres.

dayPass.note: Valid in the Courmayeur ski area only; EUR 90.00 with a Skyway Monte Bianco day added. The lift company says its Intelligent Pricing System gives the best rate when you buy online, so the figure is its list price rather than a fixed one.
